notes: Estimated cost of a model call = uncached input x input + cache reads x cacheRead + cache writes x cacheWrite (input when null) + output x output. Providers that report their own cost (the Claude Code CLI's total_cost_usd) are recorded as reported and never estimated from this table.

MiniMax-M3.notes: Standard tier, input up to 512k tokens. Above 512k input: 0.60 in / 2.40 out / 0.12 cache read. MiniMax lists no cache-write price.

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.notes: Not used yet; kept for model routing. Always thinks.

errand-script.notes: The offline scripted model (src/adapters/models/scripted.ts). Runs in-process; free.
